name: Episteme
description: Episteme turns any URL, file, dataset, repository, API or media into a clean, structured, independently verified artifact with a signed receipt.
avatarNote: Upload a brand logo image FILE (<=1MB, PNG/JPEG/WebP, non-face) — required for ASP.

services.serviceDescription:
Detects file type, size and content hashes for any agent handling untrusted files.
Provide: 1. file content (base64) or text.

Computes cryptographic digests of content for integrity and deduplication.
Provide: 1. content (base64 or text) 2. algorithms.

Verifies content against an expected hash and returns a match verdict.
Provide: 1. content (base64) 2. expected sha256.

Produces a unified diff and similarity score between two texts.
Provide: 1. text a 2. text b.

Converts length, mass, time, data and temperature units deterministically.
Provide: 1. value 2. from unit 3. to unit.

Profiles a CSV dataset with types, null counts, statistics and quality alerts.
Provide: 1. csv content.

Runs a read-only SQL query over a CSV dataset and returns rows.
Provide: 1. csv content 2. sql select.

Compares two CSV datasets and reports added, removed and schema changes.
Provide: 1. csv a 2. csv b.

Resolves a link and reports its final address, response code, content type, size and redirect count, without downloading the body.
Provide: 1. url.

Extracts the main content of a web page as clean markdown for agents.
Provide: 1. url or html.

Extracts and resolves all hyperlinks and anchor text from a web page.
Provide: 1. url or html.

Extracts structured fields from a web page using caller CSS selectors.
Provide: 1. url or html 2. selectors.

Converts PDF or text documents into clean markdown for downstream agents.
Provide: 1. document content (base64) or text.

Splits a document into overlapping, retrieval-ready chunks for grounded question answering.
Provide: 1. text 2. chunk size 3. overlap.

Inventories operations, paths and security schemes from an OpenAPI specification.
Provide: 1. openapi spec (JSON).

Applies deterministic transforms such as pick, select, flatten and keys to JSON data.
Provide: 1. data (JSON) 2. operation.

Lints an OpenAPI specification for missing titles, operation ids, responses and descriptions.
Provide: 1. openapi spec (JSON or YAML).

Compares two OpenAPI specs and flags added, removed and breaking operations.
Provide: 1. old spec 2. new spec.

Infers a JSON Schema from an example JSON value for validation and contracts.
Provide: 1. example (JSON value).

Reports image format, dimensions, mode and EXIF metadata with a content hash.
Provide: 1. image content (base64).

Resizes, converts, rotates or grayscales an image and returns a hashed artifact.
Provide: 1. image (base64) 2. operation 3. target format.

Reads PDF info or extracts, rotates and strips metadata from pages into a new document.
Provide: 1. pdf content (base64) 2. operation 3. pages.

Produces a redline and change statistics between two document texts.
Provide: 1. text a 2. text b.

Converts tabular data between CSV, JSON and JSONL formats deterministically.
Provide: 1. csv or json or jsonl 2. target format.

Validates rows against a JSON Schema and returns per-row errors and a pass rate.
Provide: 1. rows or csv 2. json schema.

Computes count, min, max, mean, standard deviation and median per numeric column.
Provide: 1. rows or csv.

Finds and removes duplicate rows by key or full match and returns duplicate clusters.
Provide: 1. rows or csv 2. key fields.

Builds a valid Vega-Lite chart specification from tabular data and field mappings.
Provide: 1. rows 2. x field 3. y field 4. mark.

Maps a codebase into languages, lines of code, symbols and dependencies for agents.
Provide: 1. files as a path to content map.

Checks source files for syntax errors, long lines, tabs and unresolved markers.
Provide: 1. files as a path to content map.

Scans code and text for leaked keys and tokens and returns redacted findings only.
Provide: 1. files as a path to content map, or text.

Chains multiple verified nodes into one artifact graph with per node signed receipts.
Provide: 1. steps as an ordered list of endpoint and input.

Runs a synthetic multi-agent scenario simulation with optional counterfactual divergence.
Provide: 1. topic 2. population 3. rounds 4. intervention strength.

Detects and redacts emails, phones, SSNs, cards and IPs from text for safe agent use.
Provide: 1. text.

Checks email syntax, disposable and role addresses and gives a deliverability guess.
Provide: 1. email address.

Joins two record sets on a shared key with inner or left semantics.
Provide: 1. left rows 2. right rows 3. join key 4. how.

Trims, collapses whitespace, lowercases and drops empty fields with a change log.
Provide: 1. rows 2. operations.

Computes added, removed and changed paths between two JSON values.
Provide: 1. object a 2. object b.

Extracts and de-duplicates URLs from a sitemap or web page for crawl planning.
Provide: 1. sitemap xml or html.

Generates typed MCP tool definitions from an OpenAPI specification.
Provide: 1. openapi spec.

Validates an MCP tools list for names, descriptions and input schemas.
Provide: 1. tools list.

Counts characters, words, sentences and lines and estimates reading time.
Provide: 1. text.

Renders a CSV dataset as a clean Markdown or grid table for reports and agents.
Provide: 1. csv 2. table format.

Independently verifies an Episteme signed receipt and its manifest for tamper detection.
Provide: 1. envelope object.

Groups rows by fields and aggregates with count, sum, average, min and max.
Provide: 1. rows 2. group by fields 3. aggregations.

Parses a robots.txt and decides whether a path is crawlable for a user agent.
Provide: 1. robots.txt content 2. path 3. user agent.

Extracts caller-defined structured fields from a document as validated JSON.
Provide: 1. document text 2. field schema.

Summarizes long text into a concise summary for downstream agents.
Provide: 1. text 2. maximum words.
